papers.title: The Reconfiguration Premium: Co-movement Structure as an Unspanned Dimension of the Variance Risk Premium

factor_candidate.name: comovement_reconfiguration_rate
factor_candidate.def: Per-stock temporal instability of market correlation: SD of rolling 3M market beta (vs KOSPI200) computed over 12 consecutive monthly snapshots. Higher = more unstable co-movement regime = higher reconfiguration rate.
factor_candidate.novel_vs_db: CR01 measures static sector correlation level; this measures TEMPORAL INSTABILITY of market beta — distinct concept, no DB entry.
factor_candidate.data_required: RAWDATA daily Ret + BM_Ret only (no options data). 13M rolling window, 1M PIT lag.
factor_candidate.implementation_note: Factor: for each stock i at month t, compute sd(beta_3m_roll) over windows [t-12,t-1] (12 monthly betas). Use OLS beta from 66-day rolling window. Long top quintile (high instability = premium-bearing). PIT: returns from [t-13M, t-1M] only.

papers.reason: Primary route = risk (co-movement structure, correlation-based). Hidden alpha: temporal beta instability is novel, KR-feasible, testable. Designated for AUTORUN.

mode_queue_meta.screen_priority_reason: Correlation matrix estimation (2nd order) with implicit dimensionality reduction via clustering. Interpretable structure for risk model.
